questions: Is this walking difficulty new or noticeably worse than usual?
Did it begin suddenly, over hours or a few days?
Have you had weakness in either leg?
Does one leg feel weaker than the other?
Have you had numbness or tingling in your legs or feet?
Have you been losing your balance or falling?
Do you feel dizzy or as though the room is spinning when you walk?
Do you have pain in your back, hips, knees, or legs?
Does pain travel from your back into either leg?
Have you had new trouble speaking, seeing, swallowing, or using an arm?
Have you lost control of your bladder or bowels?
Do your legs feel stiff or difficult to control?
Have you noticed tremor, slowed movements, or muscle stiffness?
Have you recently had a head, neck, or back injury?
Have you recently had an infection, fever, or vaccination?
Have you started or changed any medication recently?
Do you have diabetes, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, or a prior stroke?
Have you ever had similar walking problems before?
Does the problem worsen when you are tired or stressed?
Have alcohol or recreational drugs been involved recently?
